worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.summary: Crouch and pivot to carve a low ground-hugging arc: up to three foes in the arc take the cut on the shins, and a target that was moving fast cannot recover its balance, losing the most Speed; one cut hard enough also pins its leg for an instant. A spinning sweep opens a wider arc and pins longer, for a lighter cut.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.description.0: A hit on a foe deals %1$s contact damage and drops its Speed by %2$s stage(s) (Pokemon drop Speed stages, other combatants lose movement speed); the faster the target was moving, the deeper the drop.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.description.1: Sweep a %1$s-degree low fan for %2$s blocks, up to three enemies. Native body boxes must intersect the thin ankle volume: a giant's nearby feet can be hit, while a body wholly above it cannot.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.description.2: A target cut on the shins carries the wound for about %1$s; the Speed stages it lost are a lasting change and do not come back when the wound ends. Only a cut of two or more stages on a target that was hard to steady (moving fast; the spinning sweep loosens that requirement) pins its leg for about %2$s, unable to move (though it can still act).
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.whirl.on: Spinning sweep: a wider arc and a longer leg pin, at the cost of a lighter cut and longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.whirl.off: Point cut: a faster, heavier small-arc sweep that only shaves the space in front.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.growth.0: From level %1$s the cut rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.growth.1: From level %1$s the cut rises to %2$s and the wound lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.use.0: Cut a fast target's Speed at close range
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.use.2: Pivot-sweep the small ring at the feet
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.preference.wh: On: a wider sweep arc and a longer leg pin, at the cost of a lighter cut and longer recovery and cooldown. Off: a faster, heavier small-arc cut.
worldcombat.skill.lowsweep.preference.ai: It closes in before sweeping beyond this distance. Larger values commit from further out; smaller values only cut in melee.
On: prefer a fast-moving target (a deeper Speed drop). Off: treat it as an ordinary melee candidate.
